info.title: Pulse upload protocol
info.description: The HTTP surface of the Pulse upload protocol, as implemented by @mieweb/pulsevault. Generated from the plugin's route schemas — see PROTOCOL.md for the full contract.

post.description:
TUS v1 resumable upload protocol.

- `POST` creates a new upload. The `Upload-Metadata` header must include base64-encoded key/value pairs:
  - `artifactId` (or the legacy `videoid`/`projectid` aliases) — a UUID generated by your server.
  - `filename` — original filename; the extension must match the kind's allowed list.
  - `kind` — `video` (default), `project`, `captions`, or `thumbnail`. Determines the storage subdir and which completion hooks fire.
  - `relatedTo` — optional UUID of another artifact this one belongs to (e.g. the captions, beat manifest or thumbnail belonging to a pulse's video).
  - `checksum` — optional `<algorithm>:<hex digest>` of the finished file, verified post-upload if a checksum validator is configured.
- `PATCH` appends a chunk at the offset given by `Upload-Offset`, with `Content-Type: application/offset+octet-stream`.
- `HEAD` returns the current offset for a resumable upload.
- `DELETE` cancels an in-flight upload.

See https://tus.io/protocols/resumable-upload for the full protocol.

get.summary: Discover this deployment's protocol version and configuration
get.description: Unauthenticated — the response carries no secrets. Lets a client detect protocol compatibility, allowed artifact kinds/extensions and the upload size cap before pairing.

200.description: Unauthenticated discovery (PROTOCOL.md §2). A client reads it before pairing and pairs only if its protocol range overlaps [minSupportedVersion, maxSupportedVersion]. Clients must ignore fields they don't recognize.

schema.title: GET /capabilities response
schema.description: Unauthenticated discovery (PROTOCOL.md §2). A client reads it before pairing and pairs only if its protocol range overlaps [minSupportedVersion, maxSupportedVersion]. Clients must ignore fields they don't recognize.

protocolVersion.description: Protocol major this server implements. Also sent as the `Protocol-Version` header on every response.

protocolRevision.description: Spec revision this server implements, `major.minor`. The minor counts additions older clients can ignore.

minSupportedVersion.description: Oldest protocol major this server accepts. Clients whose newest protocol is older get 426 Upgrade Required.

maxSupportedVersion.description: Newest protocol major this server accepts.

allowedExtensions.description: Allowed file extensions per kind, lowercase with the leading dot.

maxUploadSize.description: Largest artifact the server accepts, in bytes.

delete.description: Deletes all storage for an artifactId (bytes + sidecar metadata), regardless of kind. Runs the `authorize` hook with `phase: "delete"` before the adapter's `remove` is called. Returns 204 on success, 404 if the artifactId was unknown, 501 if the adapter does not implement `remove`.

parameters.name: artifactId
parameters.description: UUID of the upload to delete.

501.description: Storage adapter does not implement delete.

schema.description: Storage adapter does not implement delete.

get.description: Resolves the `artifactId` through the configured storage adapter and either streams the bytes or redirects (for CDN-backed adapters). The artifact's kind (video, project, or captions) is resolved from storage, not the URL. Runs the `authorize` hook before resolve.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Optional bearer token for pre-authenticated watch links. Forwarded to the `authorize` hook as `ctx.token` so parent servers can validate it without a separate login step.

parameters.name: artifactId
parameters.description: UUID returned from the upload flow.
